method: Exact redesigned file individually viewed after its full prompt. Five equal-weight editorial dimensions, overall >=85 and each >=75, plus no watermark/text hard gate. This is an environment key-art review, not a verified playable level.
name: The Thorn Meridian
observations: All four corners and the sky are free of the visible watermark-like mark in the superseded composition.
The low channel viewpoint, foreground survey equipment and single dangling mid-distance climber materially broaden the gallery camera language.
A straight aqueduct, overgrown lateral span, separate service route and distant white watch platform establish legible geography.
Wet pale masonry, worn leather, brass plumb weight, thorn bark and autumn foliage respond distinctly to light.
The abandoned tools, fresh scored stone and dangerous rope crossing imply events and encounter consequences without showing a boss.
defectsOrLimits: The foreground scored lines are dark red-brown and can read as stained gouges rather than a uniquely identifiable arthropod track.
The dry channel retains small puddles; it reads as drained infrastructure, not uniformly dry masonry.
The full return loop and exact support engineering are not validated in this cinematic still.
